record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Judge<WH08199><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068>; for I have walked<WH01980><WTH8804> in mine integrity<WH08537>: I have trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> also in the LORD<WH03068>; <FI>therefore<Fi> I shall not slide<WH04571><WTH8799>.
Examine<WH0974><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068>, and prove<WH05254><WTH8761> me; try<WH06884><WTH8798> my reins<WH03629> and my heart<WH03820>.
For thy lovingkindness<WH02617> <FI>is<Fi> before mine eyes<WH05869>: and I have walked<WH01980><WTH8694> in thy truth<WH0571>.
I have not sat<WH03427><WTH8804> with vain<WH07723> persons<WH04962>, neither will I go in<WH0935><WTH8799> with dissemblers<WH05956><WTH8737>.
I have hated<WH08130><WTH8804> the congregation<WH06951> of evil doers<WH07489><WTH8688>; and will not sit<WH03427><WTH8799> with the wicked<WH07563>.<CM>
I will wash<WH07364><WTH8799> mine hands<WH03709> in innocency<WH05356>: so will I compass<WH05437><WTH8779> thine altar<WH04196>, O LORD<WH03068>:
That I may publish<WH08085><WTH8687> with the voice<WH06963> of thanksgiving<WH08426>, and tell<WH05608><WTH8763> of all thy wondrous works<WH06381><WTH8737>.

LORD<WH03068>, I have loved<WH0157><WTH8804> the habitation<WH04583> of thy house<WH01004>, and the place<WH04725> where thine honour<WH03519> dwelleth<WH04908>. <RF>where...: Heb. of the tabernacle of thy honour<Rf>
Gather<WH0622><WTH8799> not my soul<WH05315> with sinners<WH02400>, nor my life<WH02416> with bloody<WH01818> men<WH0582>: <RF>Gather...: or, Take not away<Rf> <RF>bloody...: Heb. men of blood<Rf>
In whose hands<WH03027> <FI>is<Fi> mischief<WH02154>, and their right hand<WH03225> is full<WH04390><WTH8804> of bribes<WH07810>. <RF>full...: Heb. filled with<Rf>
But as for me, I will walk<WH03212><WTH8799> in mine integrity<WH08537>: redeem<WH06299><WTH8798> me, and be merciful<WH02603><WTH8798> unto me.
My foot<WH07272> standeth<WH05975><WTH8804> in an even place<WH04334>: in the congregations<WH04721> will I bless<WH01288><WTH8762> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
